Steps.Text: Welcome duelist. I am Bob. Many years ago a group of adventures tried climbing this pyramid but the pyramid corrupted them and they never seen again. So this is my warning to you. Let me show you one round of it so you will be prepared.
Eight floors, three rooms each.
And that bar is your rope. Five rounds a fight, no more. Still standing when the last one burns out and the tower takes you - so every duel is a race, not a siege.
And that is what is in the way.
You. DMG is how hard your hits start out.  AP determines how much you can do.  Vitae I'll cover later.  Last is your life, drop to zero and you're done ascending.
Your dealt hand. Click that one to queue it.
That Jab cost 1 AP. You may play five cards a round, but never more AP than you have.
Now look closer. Four cards burn the same colour. Matching cards make a hand, and a hand multiplies the whole blow - so take the other three.

One of those four is a Ward - a shield, not a blow. It deals nothing, but it counts toward the hand all the same. It buys you one shield, and a shield does not eat whatever swings first - it picks their hardest blow and swallows that one.
Elemental Four of a Kind. Matching colours count, not just matching cards.
Now your hand calculates. Each attack multiplies your DMG, and your hand has its own multiplier on top.

Stop there. That card is broken - your shield went out and killed it before it could swing. It took the Drain, the biggest thing the bat had. A shield never eats whatever comes first; it always takes their worst.
Now the two it has left.

So it swung three times and landed two. One shield, one attack, and always their worst one - which is why a shield is worth more against a big hitter than against a swarm. Raise more when you expect worse.
Every blow of this climb is written down here, term by term. Open it and see what that round actually cost.
It has little left. Take it down.
Dead. Its vitae is yours, the only coin in this tower.
Every enemy has parasites you can use.
Pick the card you want changed, then click the worm that changes it.
Now your jewelry. Three on offer and coin enough for two of them - you won't survive without them, so spend it.
Take two. Any two - they are yours for the rest of the climb.

Both are on your hand now, and both are awake at once. Every card they match, they each take a turn at - so two rings that want the same card multiply together rather than taking turns. They fire left to right along this row.
One flask left to buy. Drink it.
That DMG is yours for good. A ring can be sold and a shield lasts a turn, but a draught changes the duelist - every blow you throw from here is bigger for it.
Now proceed into the next room.
Go ahead, duelist, it's time to climb.
